paper.title: QMBL: the Quantum Many-Body Leaderboard. A live record of published ground-state energies for lattice Hamiltonians
paper.authors: Tristan Zerweck, Juan Carrasquilla
paper.abstract: In condensed matter physics, scientists explore phase diagrams of matter through various methods (analysis, numerics, experiment) and achieve consensus when enough methods agree. The quality of variational results for quantum many-body ground states is mainly judged by energy values and respective errors. Here, we present QMBL, the Quantum Many-Body Leaderboard (https://www.qmbl.org), serving as the energy layer of the scientific consensus. It is a maintained, interactive record of published ground-state energies for lattice Hamiltonians. The latest release v0.4.0 holds 1434 energies on 395 instances of six model families and collects all of the community's efforts into one view. Of those instances 153 have no exact solution and any new record serves as a direct improvement to an open science problem. They are the targets of a companion benchmark, QMBL: Open Problems.

paper.title: Semiclassical Analysis of Wave Dynamics via Wigner Transforms: Applications to the Quantum Harmonic, Anharmonic, and Dirac Oscillator
paper.authors: August Burg
paper.abstract: In this Master's thesis, we give a pedagogical introduction to the semiclassical analysis of wave dynamics in single-band and multi-band systems. We show how the semiclassical evolutions of Wigner functions can approximate the dynamics of wave packet centers and wave packet deformations. Three systems of increasing complexity are considered: the quantum harmonic oscillator and the quantum anharmonic oscillator as single-band systems, and the Dirac oscillator as a two-band system. We explain the origins of the first-order semiclassical corrections (Moyal, Littlejohn-Flynn, and Berry) in the equations of motion and examine their effects on predictive accuracy. Another focus is set on the conditions for validity of the semiclassical analysis. For both the quantum anharmonic and the Dirac oscillators, a dimensionless parameter controlling the accuracy of the approximation is identified. In multi-band systems, the formalism applies only to states within a single adiabatic subspace, which, for the Dirac oscillator, corresponds to an energy branch. This motivates the construction of single-branch almost coherent states: approximately Gaussian wave packets formed by superpositions of states from a single energy branch. Their centers undergo oscillations with an aperiodic envelope. These states enable comparison between semiclassical Wigner function evolution and the commonly used Sundaram-Niu formalism. We show that semiclassical Wigner function evolution captures deformation-related dynamics, including the initial decay of oscillations, which the Sundaram-Niu formalism cannot describe by construction. Additionally, exact quantum evolution reveals partial relocalization of these single-branch almost coherent states, a phenomenon that cannot be captured by the semiclassical evolution.

paper.title: Dilaton-Axion Wormhole Partition Function Away from the BPS Endpoint
paper.authors: Soo-Jong Rey
paper.abstract: I determine the leading finite-radius correction to the two-boundary response of a charged axion wormhole near its BPS endpoint. With $\delta=a_*^2$, exact radial matching in a product axion--dilaton/saxion system gives a boundary eigenvalue that vanishes as $O(\delta)$ and an off-diagonal Hessian entry of order $O(\delta^2)$. Their combination produces a cross-boundary covariance linear in $\delta$, with a negative first sub-leading correction on the branch studied here. I determine the semiclassical range in which the quadratic approximation remains controlled and identify the first finite-radius angular resonance, $\delta^2\log(\delta/\delta_0)$. Under a uniform rescaling of all active charges, the coefficient of the linear cross-boundary response scales as the inverse square of the charge scale. I then average the inverse response over the chiral Gaussian ensemble describing the BPS endpoint. Boundary reduction preserves the hard-edge index. Multiplication by the matched BPS sector weight converts the normalized response into the leading finite-radius two-source coefficient.

paper.title: Entropy Production and Thermalization in Heavy-Quark Langevin Dynamics
paper.authors: A. M. Silva
paper.abstract: Heavy quarks are often treated as Brownian probes of the quark-gluon plasma. We formulate the irreversible entropy balance of their momentum distribution and separate the production generated by collisions from the driving caused by an evolving medium. For linear dynamics the production splits into two positive contributions, from directed momentum and from the momentum width. A static bath obeys an exact H-theorem. A cooling bath adds an explicit driving term, and longitudinal Bjorken expansion enters as a separate kinematic drive rather than as collisional production. For a Bjorken temperature protocol we derive closed-form strong- and weak-coupling limits of the total production. At strong coupling it exceeds the initial relative entropy by a term linear in the relaxation time, whose quasistatic part has the thermodynamic-length form. At weak coupling it vanishes inversely with the relaxation time. A positive strong-coupling slope therefore guarantees maximal dissipation at intermediate coupling. The same structure holds for a relativistic Fokker-Planck equation with a J\"uttner stationary state, solved numerically for charm and bottom quarks under the temperature protocol. Linear-response coefficients computed from the static generator reproduce both limits, and the numerical entropy balance is satisfied to high accuracy.

paper.title: Trapping of nanofabricated SiO$_2$ high-aspect-ratio discs in an optical lattice
paper.authors: Shelby Klomp, Shafaq Gulzar Elahi, Scott Grudichak, Chethn Galla, Zhiyuan Wang, Mark Nguyen, George Winstone, Katarina Boskovic Guy, Emma Derrick, Maddox Wroblewski, Jacob Sprague, Andrew Laeuger, Jackson Larsen, Nancy Aggarwal, Shane L. Larson, Andrew A. Geraci
paper.abstract: We describe the nanofabrication and loading of lithographically patterned, high aspect ratio $10$ $\mu$m diameter silicon dioxide discs with thickness of $400$ nm into an optical standing wave trap in vacuum. We obtain motional spectra of the center of mass motion of the discs using a combination of interferometric and imaging methods. The method is capable of high-efficiency loading and optical trapping using small numbers of objects, of the order of a few particles, with customized geometries and sizes compatible with wafer scale nanofabrication methods. Disc-like particles in optical traps have been identified as promising candidates for detectors of high frequency gravitational waves or as sensitive accelerometers.

paper.title: Universal Threshold Laws for Dipolar Evaporation of Molecular Fermi Gases
paper.authors: Kevin B. Xu, John L. Bohn, Reuben R. W. Wang
paper.abstract: Fermi statistics suppress the elastic collisions that rethermalize a Fermi gas during evaporative cooling, creating a fundamental low-temperature bottleneck for producing quantum degenerate gases. We show that, for shielded single-component ultracold dipolar molecular Fermi gases in the Wigner threshold regime, this bottleneck is governed by universal threshold laws fixed by the effective dimensionality of the gas. In this regime, Fermi suppression of rethermalization scales quadratically with temperature in 3D but only linearly in 2D. Consequently, the thermalization-to-loss ratio is more favorable in 2D than in 3D, and these results suggest that 2D geometries are better suited for reaching deep degeneracy. We also present ab initio close-coupling calculations that agree well with experimental measurements on Fermi degenerate gases of KRb molecules, supporting our conclusions.

paper.title: Area Theorems for Quantum Error Correction
paper.authors: Avijit Mandal, Mert G\"{o}kduman, Henry D. Pfister
paper.abstract: The extrinsic information transfer (EXIT) and generalized EXIT (GEXIT) area theorems provide fundamental conservation laws that connect the rate of classical codes to the performance of maximum-a-posteriori decoding on binary memoryless channels. In this work, we generalize these area theorems to quantum error correction. We first develop a coset-entropy formalism for nested linear codes, where the message specifies a coset and encoder randomization selects a codeword within that coset. The area under the resulting coset (G)EXIT function equals the normalized dimension of the quotient. For stabilizer codes, the measured syndrome restricts the Pauli error but does not always determine its logical effect, and the remaining uncertainty is an entropy over logical correction classes. We show that this entropy equals a classical coset entropy associated with the stabilizer group and the Pauli operators that commute with it. The resulting quantum GEXIT function has area equal to the number of encoded qubits per channel use for any stabilizer code, and this applies to the depolarizing channel through its joint four-valued Pauli-error distribution. For CSS codes on the quantum erasure channel and under independent bit- and phase-flip noise, the logical correction problem separates into two binary coset-decoding problems. On the quantum erasure channel, the duality between the stabilizer group and the Pauli operators that commute with it gives a folding identity at complementary erasure probabilities. Using this and the area theorem, we derive an upper bound on the rate of code families with vanishing logical error probability that matches the capacity of the quantum erasure channel. For the depolarizing channel, we also derive a rate-dependent converse, using a connection between correction-class entropy and coherent information to establish an inequality involving the complementary channel.

2610.22710.abstract_translated: 外部情報伝達 (EXIT) および一般化 EXIT (GEXIT) 面積定理は、古典符号のレートとバイナリ無記憶チャネルにおける最大事後確率復号の性能を結びつける基本的な保存則を提供します。本研究では、これらの面積定理を量子誤り訂正に一般化します。まず、ネストされた線形符号のコセットエントロピー形式を開発します。ここで、メッセージはコセットを指定し、エンコーダのランダム化によってそのコセット内の符号語が選択されます。結果として得られるコセット (G)EXIT 関数の下の面積は、商の正規化された次元に等しくなります。スタビライザー符号の場合、測定されたシンドロームはパウリ誤りを制限しますが、その論理的効果を常に決定するとは限らず、残りの不確実性は論理訂正クラスに関するエントロピーです。このエントロピーは、スタビライザー群とそれと可換なパウリ演算子に関連付けられた古典的なコセットエントロピーに等しいことを示します。結果として得られる量子 GEXIT 関数の面積は、任意の安定化符号に対してチャネル使用あたりの符号化量子ビット数に等しく、これはその結合 4 値パウリ誤り分布を通じて脱偏光チャネルにも適用されます。量子消去チャネル上の CSS 符号で、ビット反転ノイズと位相反転ノイズが独立している場合、論理訂正問題は 2 つのバイナリ剰余類復号問題に分離されます。量子消去チャネルでは、安定化群とそれと可換なパウリ演算子との間の双対性により、相補的消去確率で折り畳み恒等式が得られます。これと面積定理を使用して、量子消去チャネルの容量に一致する、論理誤り確率がゼロになる符号族のレートの上限を導出します。脱偏光チャネルについては、訂正クラスエントロピーとコヒーレント情報の間の関係を使用して相補チャネルを含む不等式を確立することにより、レート依存の逆も導出します。
2610.22710.title_translated: 量子誤り訂正のための面積定理

paper.title: Development of a fabrication-to-benchtop process for SiN-based quantum devices
paper.authors: Connor Kupchak, Abubaker Tareki, Tara Moradi, Patrick Laferriere, Niall Tait, Khaled Mnaymneh
paper.abstract: Silicon nitride has emerged as a key material for the advancement of future quantum communication and computational devices. However, challenges persist in establishing a comprehensive development process, spanning from fabrication to optical characterization, essential for advancing these devices to their next stage of potential. Maintaining control over the entire process, from start to finish, alongside device modeling, enables more efficient and timely iteration and optimization. Here we introduce a fabrication-to-benchtop process. We employ an in-house stoichiometric recipe for device fabrication and conduct comprehensive characterization of optical losses and material properties. Understanding and controlling the refractive index of the device are vital for predicting device geometries and group indices. Implementing the refractive indices of our fabricated devices, we simulate microring resonators and demonstrate their application in generating optical solitons.

2610.22776.abstract_translated: 窒化ケイ素は、将来の量子通信および量子コンピューティングデバイスの発展に不可欠な材料として注目されています。しかし、これらのデバイスを次の段階の可能性へと発展させるために不可欠な、製造から光学特性評価までを網羅する包括的な開発プロセスを確立するには、依然として課題が残っています。デバイスモデリングと並行して、プロセス全体を最初から最後まで制御することで、より効率的かつタイムリーな反復と最適化が可能になります。本稿では、製造からベンチトップまでのプロセスを紹介します。デバイス製造には社内で開発した化学量論的レシピを用い、光学損失と材料特性の包括的な特性評価を実施します。デバイスの屈折率を理解し制御することは、デバイスの形状と群屈折率を予測する上で不可欠です。製造したデバイスの屈折率を実装し、マイクロリング共振器をシミュレーションし、光ソリトン生成への応用例を示します。
2610.22776.title_translated: SiNベースの量子デバイス向け製造からベンチトップまでのプロセス開発

paper.title: Chirality-resolved imaging of spin waves with a quantum spin
paper.authors: Enbo Zhang, Tiancheng Zheng, Bo-Yuan Yang, Shreyes Nallan, Chengchao Xu, Mark Ku, Jian-Gang Zhu
paper.abstract: Spin waves carry their propagation direction in the handedness of their circularly polarized stray field, a property inaccessible to scalar magnetometers. In the Damon-Eshbach surface wave of an in-plane magnetized film, the dipolar field above the film rotates with a handedness fixed by the direction of travel. The nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centre in diamond is an intrinsic polarization analyser: a right-handed field about the NV axis drives one spin transition, and a left-handed field drives the other, in both the ground and the excited state. Here, we exploit the two excited-state transitions, which lie inside the spin-wave band of yttrium iron garnet (YIG), as a pair of chirality channels and image Damon-Eshbach waves in both directions. Because reflection from an etched boundary reverses the handedness, the incident and reflected waves appear as two lines in one spectrum and are imaged separately. In the ground state, the same rule applies, and the selected field drives Rabi oscillations, a route to chirality-selective control of the NV spin by magnons. Reading the two channels gives the direction of a spin wave at one point, without a phase reference. This advances chirality-resolved quantum sensing and provides insight into chiral spin-wave dynamics.

paper.title: Nonergodicity from Hilbert-Subspace Cloning
paper.authors: Yuuya Chiba, Ryusuke Hamazaki
paper.abstract: We identify a class of nonintegrable quantum many-body systems composed of single Pauli strings that possess an extensive number of noncommuting local conserved quantities and exhibit partial ergodicity breaking due to exponentially degenerate energy spectra. We show that such systems exhibit a novel mechanism, Hilbert-subspace cloning, where the identical chaotic Hamiltonian acts on each of exponentially many disconnected Hilbert subspaces. Although the dynamics within each clone thermalizes, quantum coherence between clones remains protected and detectable by local observables. Consequently, the long-time behavior of local observables is described by a coherence-preserving partial Gibbs ensemble, where the hidden subsystem retains its initial quantum coherence.

paper.title: From quantum emitters to technological platforms: a perspective on semiconductor quantum dots
paper.authors: Klaus D. J\"ons, Dorian A. Gangloff, Doris E. Reiter
paper.abstract: Photonic quantum technologies are based on controlled photon states. To generate these, quantum dots have emerged as excellent sources of single and entangled photons. In this Perspective, we briefly review the chronological development of quantum dots as photon sources, from their beginnings as quantum emitters in the early 2000s to the advanced photonic devices being developed today. We highlight the interplay between fundamental research and industrial aspects before discussing the photonic quantum technologies we expect to emerge in the near future.

2610.23106.abstract_translated: 光子量子技術は、制御された光子状態に基づいています。これらの光子状態を生成するために、量子ドットは単一光子および量子もつれ光子の優れた発生源として注目されています。本稿では、2000年代初頭の量子エミッターとしての黎明期から、現在開発されている高度な光子デバイスに至るまで、光子源としての量子ドットの発展を時系列に沿って概説します。基礎研究と産業的側面との相互作用に焦点を当てた後、近い将来に登場が期待される光子量子技術について議論します。
2610.23106.title_translated: 量子エミッターから技術プラットフォームへ：半導体量子ドットに関する展望

paper.title: Multiscale Quantum-Classical Simulation of Protein Autoproteolysis in a Million-Atom Membrane Environment
paper.authors: Alexander Orlov, Alexis Ralli, Tim Weaving, Michael Williams de la Bastida, Reuben Martin, Zohim Chandani, Minh Chung, P. V. Sriluckshmy, Fedor Simkovic IV, Luigi Iapichino, Peter J. Love, Christian B. Mendl, Andrea Townsend-Nicholson, Peter V. Coveney
paper.abstract: Predicting chemical reactions in biomolecules is challenging because reactive centers are embedded within complex environments that strongly influence their energetics and mechanisms. Here, we present a hybrid quantum-classical workflow that combines molecular dynamics, density functional theory, and correlated wavefunction methods, tightly integrating CPUs, GPUs, and quantum processing units (QPUs) to enable simulations across multiple length and accuracy scales. We apply this approach to ADGRG1 autoproteolysis, a maturation reaction in an adhesion G protein-coupled receptor that has not previously been studied using correlated electronic-structure methods. Our simulations treat a biologically realistic system containing more than one million atoms, including the full-length uncleaved receptor embedded in an endoplasmic-reticulum membrane, while incorporating a 54-qubit IQM quantum processor and up to 1,200 NVIDIA H100 GPUs. These results demonstrate how quantum computers can serve as accelerators within scalable scientific workflows, extending correlated electronic-structure methods to biologically relevant systems.

2610.23108.abstract_translated: 生体分子における化学反応の予測は、反応中心が複雑な環境内に埋め込まれており、その環境が反応エネルギーと反応機構に強く影響するため困難です。本稿では、分子動力学、密度汎関数理論、および相関波動関数法を組み合わせたハイブリッド量子古典ワークフローを提案します。このワークフローは、CPU、GPU、および量子処理ユニット（QPU）を緊密に統合することで、複数の長さスケールと精度スケールにわたるシミュレーションを可能にします。私たちはこのアプローチを、これまで相関電子構造法を用いて研究されてこなかった接着性Gタンパク質共役受容体の成熟反応であるADGRG1の自己分解に適用しました。私たちのシミュレーションでは、小胞体膜に埋め込まれた全長未切断受容体を含む100万個以上の原子からなる生物学的に現実的なシステムを扱い、54量子ビットのIQM量子プロセッサと最大1,200個のNVIDIA H100 GPUを組み込みました。これらの結果は、量子コンピュータがスケーラブルな科学ワークフローのアクセラレータとして機能し、相関電子構造法を生物学的に関連するシステムに拡張できることを示しています。
2610.23108.title_translated: 数百万原子からなる膜環境におけるタンパク質自己分解のマルチスケール量子古典シミュレーション

paper.title: Unconditional Quantum PAC Learning Advantage in the Large Error Regime
paper.authors: Igor C. Oliveira
paper.abstract: We establish an unconditional super-polynomial separation between quantum and classical PAC learning of Boolean functions under the uniform distribution in the large error regime. For every advantage $\lambda(n) = n^{-\omega(1)}$, we construct a concept class that a polynomial-time quantum learner learns to agreement $1/2+\lambda(n)$ with success probability at least $1-1/n^k$. The learner uses only quantum random examples and outputs a polynomial-size deterministic classical circuit. In contrast, no polynomial-time classical learner achieves agreement $1/2 + \lambda(n)/n^k$ with success probability greater than $1/n^k$, even with membership queries. To achieve this, we develop a nearly-optimal quantum learner that uses quantum random examples to produce a hypothesis achieving a prescribed correlation with an arbitrary Boolean function. The learner generalizes Fourier sampling from parity hypotheses to quadratic hypotheses. While standard Fourier sampling is insensitive to the sign of the correlation, we use interference to bias sampling toward positively correlated hypotheses. This is combined with a careful analysis of the resulting distribution to boost both the learner's success probability and its agreement with the target function. We believe that the resulting quantum learning algorithm might be of independent interest. Finally, although a robust quantum PAC learning advantage holds unconditionally in the large error regime, we note that an analogous separation between quantum and classical learning in the small error regime would imply that $\mathsf{NP} \nsubseteq \mathsf{BPP}$.

2610.23268.abstract_translated: 大きな誤差領域における一様分布の下でのブール関数の量子PAC学習と古典PAC学習の間に、無条件の超多項式分離を確立します。すべての利点$\lambda(n) = n^{-\omega(1)}$に対して、多項式時間量子学習器が少なくとも$1-1/n^k$の成功確率で$1/2+\lambda(n)$の一致を学習する概念クラスを構築します。学習器は量子ランダムサンプルのみを使用し、多項式サイズの決定論的古典回路を出力します。対照的に、メンバーシップクエリを使用しても、$1/n^k$を超える成功確率で$1/2 + \lambda(n)/n^k$の一致を達成する多項式時間古典学習器はありません。これを実現するために、量子ランダムサンプルを使用して任意のブール関数との所定の相関を達成する仮説を生成する、ほぼ最適な量子学習器を開発します。学習器は、フーリエサンプリングをパリティ仮説から二次仮説に一般化します。標準的なフーリエサンプリングは相関の符号に影響されないが、干渉を利用して正の相関を持つ仮説にサンプリングを偏らせる。これは、結果として得られる分布の慎重な分析と組み合わされ、学習器の成功確率と目標関数との一致の両方を向上させる。結果として得られる量子学習アルゴリズムは、独立した関心事となる可能性があると考えている。最後に、大きな誤差領域では堅牢な量子PAC学習の利点が無条件に成り立つが、小さな誤差領域における量子学習と古典学習の同様の分離は、$\mathsf{NP} \nsubseteq \mathsf{BPP}$を意味することに注意する。
2610.23268.title_translated: 大誤差領域における無条件量子PAC学習の優位性

paper.title: Action-Quantized Scar Multiplets and Dissipative Cat States from Fractal Period-Locking in the Open Quantum Baker Map
paper.authors: Leonardo Ermann
paper.abstract: We open the quantum baker map with a position window of width $w$ and center $q_c$. Classical pruning tiles the $(q_c,w)$ plane into diamonds where the $T$ leading resonances form root-of-unity multiplets. At $w=1/2$ one periodic orbit survives for almost every $q_c$, and the multiplets are quantized without free parameters: their modulus $2^{-1/2}$ saturates the pressure bound and their phase is the orbit action. They form cycling multicomponent cat states, and the opening becomes one mid-circuit measurement, enabling spectroscopy with $\sim10^2$ shots on quantum processors.

paper.title: Holographic two-point functions across a PT symmetry-breaking transition
paper.authors: Zuo Wang, Liang He
paper.abstract: In parity-time (PT)-symmetric non-Hermitian systems, an exceptional point, where eigenvalues and eigenvectors coalesce, typically separates a real spectrum from complex-conjugate eigenvalues. In logarithmic conformal field theories (LCFTs), such an exceptional point appears in the spectrum of scaling dimensions. Holographic models of LCFTs, such as the dipole model, are built exactly at this point. Here, we deform the holographic dipole model so that its two coalescing scaling dimensions split into either two real ones or a complex-conjugate pair. We obtain the renormalized two-point functions in closed form. They change continuously from a linear combination of two power laws, through the logarithmic form of the LCFT at the exceptional point, to log-periodic oscillations. For any pair of scalar primary operators with real mixing under dilatations, the conformal Ward identities fix this form up to two normalization constants, which the holographic dictionary determines. In PT-symmetric theories with such a dilatation operator, real and complex-conjugate scaling dimensions correspond to the PT-unbroken and PT-broken phases. In the BTZ black hole at finite temperature, the difference between the quasinormal frequencies associated with the two scaling dimensions changes from purely imaginary to purely real across the real-to-complex spectral transition. Correspondingly, the linear response changes from overdamped to underdamped, with critical damping at the exceptional point.

paper.title: Impact of Irrep Truncations on Quantum Simulations of QCD
paper.authors: Patrick Draper, Drishti Gupta
paper.abstract: Quantum simulations of lattice gauge theories with continuous gauge groups require a choice of basis (how states of the gauge theory map to the qubit computational basis) and truncation scheme (which of the infinitely many gauge theory basis states should be omitted in the map to the finite dimensional qubit Hilbert space.) The most common choices are adapted to an electric basis for the gauge theory, where the basis states for each link are associated with irreducible representations of the gauge group. Electric bases and truncations are generally advantageous for preserving gauge symmetries and simulating the strong coupling regime, but their effectiveness in the weak coupling regimes of physical interest are less well understood. In this work, we compute relative probabilities $p(R')/p(R)$ for finding a link in the irreps $R,R'$ in the ground state of SU(3) lattice gauge theory using Euclidean Monte Carlo methods and weak-coupling lattice perturbation theory. The observables that compute these relative probabilities are constructed by introducing seams into an anisotropic lattice, and by a similar construction we are also able to measure relative probabilities of different site singlets (ways that electric flux braids together into a gauge singlet) at each vertex. With these methods we can quantify, for example, the importance of higher electric flux states in the weak coupling ground state. These results directly inform what truncations are needed to accurately capture non-abelian gauge dynamics near the continuum limit.

2610.23681.abstract_translated: 連続ゲージ群を持つ格子ゲージ理論の量子シミュレーションでは、基底（ゲージ理論の状態が量子ビット計算基底にどのようにマッピングされるか）と切り捨てスキーム（無限に存在するゲージ理論基底状態のうち、有限次元量子ビットヒルベルト空間へのマッピングで省略すべき状態）の選択が必要です。最も一般的な選択肢は、ゲージ理論の電気基底に適用され、各リンクの基底状態はゲージ群の既約表現に関連付けられます。電気基底と切り捨ては、ゲージ対称性を保持し、強結合領域をシミュレートするのに一般的に有利ですが、物理的に関心のある弱結合領域での有効性はあまりよく理解されていません。この研究では、ユークリッドモンテカルロ法と弱結合格子摂動理論を使用して、SU(3)格子ゲージ理論の基底状態における既約表現$R,R'$内のリンクを見つける相対確率$p(R')/p(R)$を計算します。これらの相対確率を計算する観測量は、異方性格子に継ぎ目を導入することによって構築され、同様の構成により、各頂点における異なるサイトシングレット（電束がゲージシングレットに絡み合う様式）の相対確率も測定できます。これらの方法を用いることで、例えば、弱結合基底状態における高次電束状態の重要性を定量化できます。これらの結果は、連続極限付近の非可換ゲージダイナミクスを正確に捉えるためにどのような切り捨てが必要かを直接的に示します。
2610.23681.title_translated: 既約項の切り捨てがQCDの量子シミュレーションに与える影響

paper.title: Scaling of entanglement with distance between subsystems: detection of phase transitions in the $t'$-$\pi$-flux model
paper.authors: Maksim Ulybyshev, Gerg\H{o} Ro\'osz, Gabriele Bellomia, Karsten Held, Fakher Assaad, Frederic Bippus
paper.abstract: The system-size scaling of bipartite entanglement can be used to detect phase transitions. We develop a related approach for strongly correlated electron models where large density matrices or large system size scaling are inaccessible. To this end, we demonstrate that phase transitions of various kinds are signaled by a sharp signature in the first- or second-order logarithmic derivatives of the negativity measuring entanglement between small clusters at varying distances. Crucially, we show how to mitigate the effect of quantum Monte Carlo noise at large distances when computing the negativity. Our focus is on the $t'$-$\pi$-flux Hubbard model using auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo simulations. It has the particular advantage of showing three distinct phase transitions in a single model: semimetal to band insulator, semimetal to antiferromagnetic Mott insulator, and a magnetic order-disorder transition belonging to the Gaussian, Gross-Neveu, and O(3) Wilson-Fisher universality classes, respectively.

2610.23770.abstract_translated: 二体エンタングルメントのシステムサイズスケーリングは、相転移の検出に利用できます。我々は、大きな密度行列や大きなシステムサイズスケーリングが利用できない強相関電子モデルに対して、関連するアプローチを開発しました。この目的のために、様々な種類の相転移が、距離の異なる小さなクラスター間のエンタングルメントを測定するネガティビティの1次または2次の対数微分における鋭い特徴によって示されることを実証しました。重要なことに、ネガティビティを計算する際に、大きな距離での量子モンテカルロノイズの影響を軽減する方法を示しました。我々の焦点は、補助場量子モンテカルロシミュレーションを使用した$t'$-$\pi$-フラックスハバードモデルです。このモデルは、半金属からバンド絶縁体、半金属から反強磁性モット絶縁体、そしてガウス、グロス・ネーヴ、O(3)ウィルソン・フィッシャーの普遍性クラスにそれぞれ属する磁気秩序-無秩序転移という、3つの異なる相転移を1つのモデルで示すという特別な利点を持っています。
2610.23770.title_translated: サブシステム間の距離によるエンタングルメントのスケーリング：t'-πフラックスモデルにおける相転移の検出

paper.title: Transport and thermalization under noncommuting localized constraints
paper.authors: Amir Nesturov, Attila Tak\'acs, Lenart Zadnik
paper.abstract: We investigate the effects of spatially localized conserved quantities on transport and thermalization in quantum and classical many-body systems. We consider several related models: the integrable quantum Volterra model, its nonintegrable classical limit, and two cellular automata derived from the latter. Although localized constraints are often associated with lattice gauge theories, our models do not admit such an interpretation. In systems with discrete degrees of freedom, these constraints induce uniform fragmentation of the Hilbert or configuration space. In the quantum Volterra model, we derive an exact mapping of the dynamics within each Hilbert-space fragment onto a quantum chiral Potts chain. We find that energy transport is ballistic, with identical transport coefficients across all fragments. In the nonintegrable classical limit, energy transport is diffusive, and we similarly find the diffusion constant to be independent of whether or not the constraints are fixed (resolved). Finally, in the cellular automata, we show that, despite leaving transport unaffected, localized constraints lead to a strong breakdown of local ergodicity.

paper.title: Experimental Demonstration of a Balanced Travelling Wave Parametric Amplifier
paper.authors: Nikita Klimovich, Peter K. Day, Henry G. Leduc, Boon-Kok Tan
paper.abstract: Superconducting travelling-wave parametric amplifiers (TWPAs) provide broadband gain, low added noise, and high dynamic range, making them attractive for applications requiring wide instantaneous bandwidth. This is crucial for amplifying multiplexed narrow band signals spread over a wide frequency range, such as qubit resonator arrays, or amplifying inherently wide band signals, such as in spectrometers or radiometers. In many cases, however, the useful bandwidth of a TWPA is limited by the production of the idler tone at an image frequency. For three-wave-mixing (3WM) TWPAs, for example, an input signal at $f_s$ is indistinguishable from one at $f_p - f_s$, which can produce spectral ambiguity when the input spectrum is broadband or not known in advance. We experimentally demonstrate a balanced architecture that doubles the instantaneous image-rejected bandwidth available to a 3WM TWPA by spatially separating the amplified signal from the output pump and generated idler, which resolves the sideband degeneracy. The architecture consists of two amplifiers connected between a pair of 180$^{\circ}$ hybrid couplers, with the signal and pump injected and output through the sum and difference ports, respectively. Using two kinetic-inductance TWPAs, we demonstrate approximately 20 dB of signal gain across nearly an octave of bandwidth, together with pump rejection below --20 dB and an average image rejection of approximately --15 dB over the operating band. These results establish balanced TWPAs as a practical approach to broadband parametric amplification, enabling improved contamination free bandwidth and eliminating the need for complex filtering.

2610.23810.abstract_translated: 超伝導進行波パラメトリック増幅器（TWPA）は、広帯域ゲイン、低付加ノイズ、高ダイナミックレンジを提供するため、広い瞬時帯域幅を必要とするアプリケーションに魅力的です。これは、キュービット共振器アレイなどの広い周波数範囲に広がる多重化された狭帯域信号を増幅する場合や、分光計や放射計などの本質的に広帯域の信号を増幅する場合に重要です。しかし多くの場合、TWPAの有効帯域幅は、イメージ周波数でのアイドラートーンの生成によって制限されます。たとえば、3波混合（3WM）TWPAの場合、$f_s$の入力信号は$f_p - f_s$の入力信号と区別できないため、入力スペクトルが広帯域である場合や事前にわかっていない場合にスペクトル曖昧性が生じる可能性があります。本稿では、増幅信号を出力ポンプおよび生成されたアイドラから空間的に分離することで、サイドバンド縮退を解消し、3WM TWPAで利用可能な瞬時イメージ除去帯域幅を2倍にするバランス型アーキテクチャを実験的に実証する。このアーキテクチャは、一対の180°ハイブリッドカプラ間に接続された2つのアンプで構成され、信号とポンプはそれぞれ和ポートと差ポートから注入および出力される。2つのキネティックインダクタンスTWPAを使用することで、約1オクターブの帯域幅にわたって約20 dBの信号利得、-20 dB以下のポンプ除去、および動作帯域全体で平均約-15 dBのイメージ除去を実現した。これらの結果は、バランス型TWPAが広帯域パラメトリック増幅の実用的なアプローチであることを示しており、汚染のない帯域幅の改善と複雑なフィルタリングの必要性の排除を可能にする。
2610.23810.title_translated: 平衡進行波パラメトリック増幅器の実験的実証

paper.title: Anyonic Neural Network Wavefunctions
paper.authors: Andres Perez Fadon, Pok Man Tam, Leyna Shackleton
paper.abstract: The macroscopic behavior of a non-interacting gas of Abelian anyons has remained unsettled for many decades. Prior numerical methods employing exact diagonalization in the continuum and on the plane have been limited to small system sizes, at most $N = 4$ anyons. Using the rapidly developing technology of neural network wavefunctions, we develop variational ansatze appropriate for studying continuum models of the Abelian anyon gas. The neural network architecture, which we call "AnyNet", is capable of exactly enforcing the non-analytic short-distance behavior induced by the anyonic statistics. We demonstrate excellent agreement with exact diagonalization for $N=4$ anyons, obtain accurate results up to $N = 16$ for intermediate statistics, and study up to $N=20$ for almost-fermionic anyons, matching perturbative results within a 0.4% discrepancy. We use this methodology to study anyons in a harmonic trap, and anyonic atoms as a model for anyon binding to impurities. We study the structure of anyonic wavefunctions as the statistics parameter is varied. We focus on the single-particle density, the pair density, the angular momentum, and the scaling of the wavefunction as multiple anyons coalesce. This work opens doors to understanding the macroscopic behavior of anyons, for which rich phases have been predicted theoretically.

2610.23815.abstract_translated: 非相互作用のアーベルアニオンガスの巨視的挙動は、何十年もの間未解決のままであった。連続体および平面上で厳密対角化を用いる従来の数値計算法は、最大でも $N = 4$ 個のアニオンという小さなシステムサイズに限定されていた。急速に発展しているニューラルネットワーク波動関数の技術を用いて、アーベルアニオンガスの連続体モデルの研究に適した変分アンザッツを開発した。我々が「AnyNet」と呼ぶニューラルネットワークアーキテクチャは、アニオン統計によって誘発される非解析的な短距離挙動を厳密に強制することができる。$N=4$ アニオンについては厳密対角化との優れた一致を示し、中間統計については $N = 16$ まで正確な結果を得て、ほぼフェルミオン的なアニオンについては $N=20$ まで研究し、摂動論的結果と 0.4% の誤差で一致させた。本研究では、調和トラップ内のアニオン、および不純物へのアニオン結合のモデルとしてのアニオン原子を研究するために、この手法を用います。統計パラメータを変化させながら、アニオン波動関数の構造を調べます。特に、単一粒子密度、対密度、角運動量、および複数のアニオンが合体する際の波動関数のスケーリングに焦点を当てます。この研究は、理論的に多様な相が予測されているアニオンの巨視的な振る舞いを理解するための扉を開くものです。

paper.title: Cryptographically Secure Agent-to-Agent Communication in Multi-Agent Systems
paper.authors: Karol Budzyn, Adrian Brodzik, Mateusz Szczepkowski
paper.abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) comprise AI agents that collaborate or compete to perform complex, distributed tasks. Their dynamic interactions create opportunities for threat actors to target and impersonate other agents, intercept messages, inject malicious prompts, and exfiltrate sensitive data while simultaneously complicating the detection of anomalous behavior through conventional monitoring. This paper surveys threats and cryptographic challenges in agent-to-agent communication and presents a zero-trust architecture integrating identity, transport security, message integrity, and monitoring. The architecture establishes agent identities via decentralized identifiers and task-scoped verifiable credentials backed by a permissioned ledger, enforcing least-privilege authorization. For transport security, it provides mutually authenticated, crypto-agile TLS with hybrid post-quantum key establishment, and evaluates KEMTLS with pre-distributed public keys to reduce handshake overhead. Signed CBOR envelopes preserve payload integrity across multi-hop exchanges, while zero-knowledge proofs verify declared task constraints without exposing underlying inputs. Context-aware monitoring of inter-agent messages, tool activity, and execution telemetry informs the setting of risk-based trust thresholds and supports the detection of behavioral anomalies. Together, these mechanisms provide an integrated framework for securing and auditing agent communication, with implications for other agentic protocols and prospective 6G semantic communication.

2610.23078.abstract_translated: マルチエージェントシステム（MAS）は、複雑な分散タスクを実行するために連携または競合するAIエージェントで構成されます。これらのエージェント間の動的な相互作用により、攻撃者は他のエージェントを標的にしてなりすまし、メッセージを傍受し、悪意のあるプロンプトを挿入し、機密データを流出させる機会を得ると同時に、従来の監視による異常な動作の検出を困難にします。本稿では、エージェント間通信における脅威と暗号化上の課題を概説し、ID、トランスポートセキュリティ、メッセージの完全性、および監視を統合したゼロトラストアーキテクチャを提案します。このアーキテクチャは、分散型識別子と、許可型台帳によって裏付けられたタスクスコープの検証可能な資格情報を使用してエージェントのIDを確立し、最小権限の認可を強制します。トランスポートセキュリティに関しては、相互認証された暗号的に柔軟なTLSとハイブリッドポスト量子鍵確立を提供し、ハンドシェイクのオーバーヘッドを削減するために、事前に配布された公開鍵を使用してKEMTLSを評価します。署名付きCBORエンベロープは、マルチホップ交換全体でペイロードの完全性を維持し、ゼロ知識証明は、基となる入力を公開することなく、宣言されたタスク制約を検証します。エージェント間のメッセージ、ツールのアクティビティ、および実行テレメトリのコンテキスト認識型モニタリングは、リスクベースの信頼閾値の設定に役立ち、行動異常の検出をサポートします。これらのメカニズムを組み合わせることで、エージェント間の通信を保護および監査するための統合フレームワークが実現し、他のエージェントプロトコルや将来の6Gセマンティック通信にも影響を与えます。

paper.title: RAMP: Toward Ubiquitous Quantum-Safe Key Distribution as a Service
paper.authors: Jiafan Wang, Sebastian Kish, Dongxi Liu
paper.abstract: Quantum key distribution (QKD) offers a security foundation independent of computational hardness assumptions. However, its reliance on specialized hardware limits access by ordinary users. Turning QKD into a service poses a fundamental trust challenge, as the providers that supply QKD-derived material themselves could retain knowledge of the keying inputs of users. This makes end-to-end confidentiality solely depend on the trustworthiness of the service infrastructure. We present RAMP, a service-oriented framework that decouples QKD material generation from key consumption. Providers operate QKD infrastructure and supply raw-key materials, while users securely acquire, mask, and locally process them into final keys without operating QKD devices. RAMP employs reconciliation-preserving masking compatible with both DV- and CV-QKD. It mitigates the trust dependence by separating the QKD-service and user-side masking domains. We formalize complementary confidentiality guarantees: RAMP protects the final key even if colluding providers expose their complete raw-key views, provided the masking domain remains secure; conversely, exposing the complete masking state does not break final-key secrecy as long as the QKD source and acquisition paths remain protected. The results establish the dual-domain security boundary of RAMP. We implement RAMP using experimentally acquired QKD data and standardized quantum-safe cryptography. After acquiring service-provisioned keying material, commodity endpoints complete user-side QKD post-processing with an average key-distillation throughput of 2.1Kb/s on an M4 Pro CPU. To our knowledge, we demonstrate the first experimental realization of such service-provisioned, user-side QKD processing, presenting a viable path toward QKD as a service.

2610.22879.abstract_translated: 量子鍵配送（QKD）は、計算困難性の仮定に依存しないセキュリティ基盤を提供します。しかし、専用ハードウェアへの依存により、一般ユーザーのアクセスは制限されます。QKDをサービス化することは、根本的な信頼性の課題となります。なぜなら、QKD由来の材料を提供するプロバイダー自身が、ユーザーの鍵入力に関する知識を保持する可能性があるからです。これにより、エンドツーエンドの機密性は、サービスインフラストラクチャの信頼性のみに依存することになります。本稿では、QKD材料の生成と鍵の消費を分離するサービス指向フレームワークであるRAMPを提案します。プロバイダーはQKDインフラストラクチャを運用し、生鍵材料を提供します。一方、ユーザーはQKDデバイスを操作することなく、それらを安全に取得、マスキングし、ローカルで処理して最終的な鍵を作成します。RAMPは、DV-QKDとCV-QKDの両方と互換性のある、調整を保持するマスキングを採用しています。QKDサービスとユーザー側のマスキングドメインを分離することで、信頼性への依存を軽減します。我々は補完的な機密性保証を形式化する。RAMPは、共謀するプロバイダが完全な生鍵ビューを公開した場合でも、マスキングドメインが安全であれば最終鍵を保護する。逆に、QKDソースと取得パスが保護されている限り、完全なマスキング状態を公開しても最終鍵の機密性は損なわれない。これらの結果により、RAMPの二重ドメインセキュリティ境界が確立される。我々は、実験的に取得したQKDデータと標準化された量子安全暗号を使用してRAMPを実装する。サービス提供された鍵マテリアルを取得した後、市販のエンドポイントは、M4 Pro CPU上で平均2.1Kb/sの鍵蒸留スループットでユーザー側のQKD後処理を完了する。我々の知る限り、このようなサービス提供されたユーザー側のQKD処理の実験的実現はこれが初めてであり、サービスとしてのQKDへの実現可能な道筋を示すものである。
2610.22879.title_translated: RAMP：ユビキタスな量子安全鍵配布サービスに向けて
